name: project-context-curator
description: Proactively maintains durable repository domain context for fresh agent sessions.

thread.text: Capture durable new learnings in docs/context. Capturing durable project-level insight is part of the work, not a follow-up — the turn you verify a stable term, component, API, ownership boundary, architecture rule, environment mapping, or deployment convention from repo evidence or user confirmation, run the updater that same turn before you reply.

interface.longDescription: Project Context Curator helps agents automatically activate project-context curation, proactively store durable repo/user-confirmed insights, detect unclear project terms, ask concise clarification questions, and update local ignored context files under docs/context for future sessions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Maintain project context while working in this repository.
